title: Market Data Portfolio
description: Built a production-grade stock portfolio web application with real-time market data, dynamic holdings tracking, and transaction journaling. Implemented a balance calculator, customizable data grids with sorting and filtering, and automated refresh to keep views current. Delivered a responsive Angular UI with sticky headers, modal workflows, and mobile-first layouts.

title: FormatLens — JSON & Technical Text Inspector
description: Built a privacy-first Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome extension that turns dense JSON, logs, API responses, and technical text into a readable side-panel workspace without leaving the source page. Designed for real troubleshooting scenarios—including ServiceNow request payloads—with selection, focused-field, and Pick Element extraction; escaped and nested JSON detection; syntax-highlighted Pretty, collapsible Tree, and Raw views; search across keys, values, text, and JSON paths; and precise value or path copying. All content is processed locally with no backend, analytics, or data transmission.

title: Transcript Capture for Teams
description: Built a privacy-first Microsoft Edge extension to solve a recurring workplace problem: reliably saving completed Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts for follow-up, documentation, and knowledge sharing. The extension is started explicitly by the user, navigates Teams' virtualized transcript list in both directions to capture every available row, verifies coverage and flags missing rows, then exports ordered speaker names, timestamps, transcript text, and transcription events as a local plain-text file. All processing stays in the selected browser tab—no accounts, analytics, remote services, or third-party data transfer.

title: NowLayer — Game-Safe Media Overlay
description: Designed and built a standalone Windows desktop application that keeps music controls, live now-playing details, and compatible video Picture-in-Picture visible above games and everyday apps—reducing the need to Alt+Tab. Implemented a lockable click-through overlay so mouse input passes safely to the game, configurable hotkeys, layout and opacity controls, system-tray operation, and clock, countdown, and alarm utilities. Added clear compatibility boundaries for windowed and borderless games, exclusive fullscreen, media-session support, and protected video capture.

title: Buff Discord Music Bot
description: Developed a feature-rich Discord music bot with queue management, loop modes, and granular playback controls. Integrated YouTube and Spotify sources with FFmpeg-based streaming to enable stable, low-latency playback. Containerized with Docker for reproducible deployments and simplified operations.

title: Microsoft Rewards Automation
description: Authored a Python automation utility to complete daily Microsoft Rewards tasks using Selenium-driven browser flows. Added configurable delays, error handling, and structured logging to improve reliability and repeatability. Reduced manual effort while ensuring consistent task completion.

title: RP Server Development
description: Architected and developed a GTA V roleplay server on RAGE Multiplayer featuring jobs, housing, vehicles, and economy systems. Emphasized scalable server logic, persistent data models, and engaging gameplay loops. Implemented modular features to simplify ongoing updates and community-driven expansions.

title: Calendar Event Manager
description: Built a desktop application to create, update, and manage Google Calendar events with secure account integration. Designed an intuitive interface with clear event forms, date pickers, and actionable status feedback. Streamlined routine scheduling to reduce friction and user error.
